description: This file implements a Speechmatics Text-to-Speech (TTS) service integration in Python. It provides a class `SpeechmaticsTTSService` that uses the Speechmatics HTTP API to convert text into raw PCM audio streams, supporting retries, streaming, and metrics. The class inherits from a generic `TTSService` and manages API interactions, response streaming, and error handling.
